message.content:
This is a zinc alloy ring that is a part solely for an electric toothbrush. Electric toothbrushes are classified in 8509.80 (electromechanical domestic appliances with self-contained electric motor, other appliances). Parts of those appliances fall under 8509.90. Specifically, 8509.90.45 covers parts of "other" appliances (8509.80), and 8509.90.65 is also a candidate.

The HTSUS breakdown for 8509.90 is:
- 8509.90.10: Parts of floor polishers, etc.
- 8509.90.25: Parts of food grinders, food mixers, fruit or vegetable juice extractors (parts)
- 8509.90.45: Parts, other: of goods of subheading 8509.40 (?)
- 8509.90.65: Other parts, of 8509.80 other (?)

Recalling the actual structure: 8509.90.05 Of goods of 8509.10 (vacuum cleaners); 8509.90.10 Of 8509.40; 8509.90.15 ...; 8509.90.25 Of 8509.80 (other) of cast metal?; 8509.90.45 Other: Of 8509.40 or similar; 8509.90.65 Other.

The structure is 8509.90: Parts: Of the machines of 8509.10 → 8509.90.05; Of 8509.40 → 8509.90.15 / .20; Other: 8509.90.25 Of cast metal?; 8509.90.45 Other: Of 8509.80...; 8509.90.65 Other.

I believe 8509.90.25 is "Of the goods of subheading 8509.40 / 8509.80 - Of zinc?". There is a risk here. Rulings on toothbrush parts go to 8509.90.65 ("Other"), and since a die-cast zinc ring isn't a motor part, I'll pick 8509.90.65.
